findings.text: issue (blocking): the version bump moved both loom-workflow manifests to 4.3.1 and left the root README's version cell at 4.3.0, which test_independent_advisor_plugin_readmes.py:54 binds; the declared runner is fail-fast, so the whole suite aborted there and Acceptance 1 could not be measured at all

findings.text: issue (blocking): the change's whole mechanism is git fast-import's stream grammar and its --export-marks semantics, a CLI contract the author does not own, and the delta cited nothing for it while this repo cites git-scm.com for far less obscure git flags in nine places
findings.fix: cite git-fast-import(1) for the field order and the marks semantics, and mirror the citation in the shell emitter
findings.resolved: fixed in 1195ae5eb and refined in 610d8f6f5; the reviewer checked the cited spans against the local man page and confirmed the commit/data section split in round 3

findings.text: issue: _cleanup_whitespace used bare bytes.rstrip(), which strips 0x0b and 0x0c; git's sane_isspace does not, so the docstring's claim to reproduce --cleanup=whitespace was broader than the code delivered. A 2019-case differential fuzz against real git commit -F - found 910 mismatches, all of that one class
findings.fix: rstrip only git's whitespace set and scope the docstring's claim to it
findings.resolved: fixed in 1195ae5eb; the reviewer re-ran the identical 2019-case fuzz in round 2 and reports zero mismatches

findings.text: issue: the probe case whose purpose is to catch the whitespace divergence could not see it — its seven bodies contained only spaces and newlines, so the 0x0b/0x0c class passed through the oracle untested
findings.fix: add bodies carrying both bytes, including each alone in a trailing position, and observe them red before the fix
findings.resolved: fixed in 1195ae5eb; three cases added, seen red against the pre-fix implementation and green after, and the reviewer independently confirmed all three are the discriminating set

findings.text: issue: the rebuilt builders' shape read-back compared output against the builder's own parameters, so it held for any value of them; four perturbations of the contracted 200/40/5 shape, including the one the comment named as its worked example, all built with nothing firing, contradicting the memory entry this same change commits
findings.fix: make the read-back absolute — module constants and required arguments, with the caller passing the contracted sizes
findings.resolved: fixed in 1195ae5eb; both reviewers re-ran all four perturbations in round 2 and each now fires with a named message, while the contracted shape still builds and every fixture stays byte-identical

findings.text: issue: the timing evidence attributed its runs to the branch HEAD when they were taken five commits earlier, at a tree where the suite was in fact red, and its diff list was stale — so the record offered as proof of Acceptance 1, 2 and 5 no longer reproduced, which is why the red suite reached the review station unseen
findings.fix: re-run the declared command on the fixed tree and rewrite the totals, the per-group table and the path list against the sha actually measured
findings.resolved: rewritten in d00bc970a, corrected again in 610d8f6f5 and restated as a property rather than a path list in 40a929290; both reviewers ran the declared suite themselves at the final sha and confirmed exit 0 under the bound
